Settings.UpdateBody: Check on startup. Ignored versions will not show a notification.
Update.Ignored: This version is ignored. A newer version will notify you again.
Update.NotFound: No update manifest has been published (404). Recorded in the log.
Update.Failed: The update check or action failed. Please retry later; details are in work logs.
Update.AlreadyChecking: An update check is already in progress. Please wait.
Home.Title: Welcome to Geek Flash X
Home.Subtitle: Start here to explore flashing resources, connect with the tech community, and make device flashing easier.
Home.About.Title: About This Tool
Home.About.Body: Geek Flash X is an open-source flashing tool built for geeks, with versatile features and support for multiple chip protocols, aiming to let everyone flash devices without restrictions.
Home.About.Detail: Here you can quickly find firmware, flashing, and other resources and tools.
Home.Links.Title: Resources & community

Home.Links.Footer: Explore with the community, share what you learn, and keep track of every step.
